Input image 1 is the strict character identity and style reference, not a background to preserve. Make the exact same extremely cute TWO-HEADS-TALL chibi human girl: oversized round head about half the full height, tiny torso and short legs, long orange hair, large amber eyes, orange flower and black ribbon on viewer's RIGHT, white-and-orange floral long dress with black ribbon accents, white lace-up shoes, and the same dark book with an orange flower emblem. Preserve her head/body proportion, face, hair ornament, palette, linework, clothing and shoes in every cell. No tail, animal ears or horns. Do not revert to a three/four-heads-tall girl.
Create ONE square high-resolution 4-by-4 atlas (prefer 2048x2048). Exactly 16 equal invisible cells: four columns, four rows, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. TOP TWO ROWS are action A's eight sequential key poses. BOTTOM TWO ROWS are action B's eight sequential key poses. There is exactly one full-body girl in each cell: 16 instances of the same character at successive times, NOT 16 different characters.
Each eight-frame action must contain visibly distinct, plausible continuous motion with preparation, response and return/settle; no eight identical copies. Changes between neighboring frames are small, anatomically coherent, with consistent face/head scale and stable placement. Start/end silhouettes must join naturally. Keep a fixed camera and fixed scale, align the soles to the same baseline, center the entire figure including hair, ornament, book, and shoes, and leave at least TEN PERCENT clear padding on every side of EACH cell. Never crop hair, fingers, book or feet; never let a figure cross a cell boundary. Intentional limb motion is allowed, random scale/vertical jitter is not.
Maintain exactly two arms and two hands. When a hand is used for an action, keep the book visibly supported in the other arm; never duplicate, lose, teleport or merge the book or hands. Every prop must remain coherent frame to frame.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha across the entire sheet and between figures. No backdrop, white/color fill, checkerboard, glow, ground plane, contact/drop shadow, scenery, labels, letters, digits, watermarks, visible grid or borders. White dress details remain opaque. Clean alpha edges. Do not paint a background.
